ModMetaData.name: RimWar Empire Wartime Economy (戰時經濟)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
The Rim War world situation now feeds back into your Empire (Refactored) vassal economy: the missing "RimWar -> Empire" causal link.
- Besieged settlements lose production. When a Rim War warband is attacking one of your vassal settlements (the settlement's RimWar comp reports attacking units), that settlement's resource output is multiplied down by a configurable factor until the siege lifts. - Wartime tax surcharge. While your empire's faction is at war in Rim War (its RimWarData has war factions), every vassal's tax silver is increased by a configurable percentage to fund the war effort.
All signals are read-only from Rim War's public state (RimWarSettlementComp.AttackingUnits / UnderAttack, WorldUtility.GetRimWarDataForFaction(...).IsAtWar / WarFactions). The Empire side uses zero Harmony patches: the besieged production cut is a WorldObjectComp implementing Empire's IResourceProductionModifier, and the wartime tax is an ITaxTickParticipant registered in TaxTickRegistry. Registrations are re-applied after Game.ClearCaches (new game / load) via EmpireCacheUtil.RegisterCacheInvalidator.
Requires Empire (Refactored) and Rim War.
